title: Add GameInfoCacheReset engine
description: The engine behind "Hard Refresh Game Info": wipes Playdock's own downloadable game metadata + art (in memory via the three new clear() calls, on disk by removing its two cache folders). Deliberately never touches Steam's own appcache/librarycache.
commit_message: Add GameInfoCacheReset engine for Hard Refresh Game Info
